summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 5, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that a longstanding global logistics client placed additional orders for two RIO Mini security units and two TOM visitor management units at an existing facility. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, regulatory clock, or structural mechanic is disclosed. The filing is a product-order commercial update, not an acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, activist, or restructuring event, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
